resources.string: The required Android administrative role is available. Reset permanently erases device data. Back up important files first.
Android requires you to explicitly activate device administrator permission before this legacy reset method can run.
Raha Fast Reset only uses this permission when you press Reset. No network or remote actions.

On the managed build, Android permits device-wide reset only for a provisioned Device Owner. Installing an ordinary app does not grant this role. Provision on a dedicated test device or use the system reset settings.
This app refuses to erase only a secondary user or work profile while claiming to reset the whole device.

If enabled, pressing the large Reset button will immediately request a factory reset without another confirmation. All local personal data may be permanently lost. Only enable this on a device you own and intend to erase.
This operation may permanently delete photos, files, apps, accounts and local data. Back up your device. The operation cannot be undone. Do you want to continue?
The requested reset did not start (%1$s). Verify the administrative role and Android version. No bypass is attempted.
This app does not bypass Factory Reset Protection (FRP), erase external SD cards, remove accounts in cloud backups, or guarantee secure erasure of every storage medium.
Android administrator access will be removed and the legacy reset feature will no longer be available until you enable it again.
The Device Owner role is managed by Android provisioning and cannot be removed by this ordinary in-app toggle. Reset or reprovision a test device using approved tools.
